preconditions.description: The number of members n is between 3 and 150,000 inclusive.
The number of friend pairs m is non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct members within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges))
preconditions.description: No pair of members appears more than once in the input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if all((x, z) in edge_set or (z, x) in edge_set for x, y, z in triples if (x, y) in edge_set or (y, x) in edge_set) and (y, z) in edge_set or (z, y) in edge_set else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if for every triplet of distinct members (X, Y, Z), the existence of edges X-Y and Y-Z implies the existence of edge X-Z; otherwise output 'NO'.
